audio_master.purpose: accepted video-assemble output after optional licensed SFX finishing; the packaging revision must preserve its audio stream

input_contract.source_timebase: Paths must preserve the episode timecodes used by clip_plan.json and picture-conform.json.
input_contract.video: Pre-normalized SDR, square pixels, BT.709 primaries/transfer/matrix, limited range. The example does not guess a Dolby Vision to SDR transform.
input_contract.audio: 48 kHz stereo is recommended. Licensed episode audio, narration, music, and effects are supplied by the user and are not distributed here.
